_comment: Virginia golden-set eval fixture for AHJ Wizard extraction scoring. The fire-separation canary (R302.2.2) must be a 'found' item (not a gap) for the run to pass. Items with isMaterialCanary=true must have non-['all'] materialApplicability.
codeEdition: 2021 Virginia Residential Code (VRC) / 2021 Virginia Existing Building Code (VEBC)

goldenItems.description: Virginia Residential Code governing-code authority — USBC Part I adopts IRC with Virginia amendments
Reroofing in flood hazard areas — additional requirements for existing roofs in SFHA zones
Roof replacement in flood hazard areas — compliance with new construction provisions when >50% replacement
Underlayment for asphalt shingles — Class D felt or ASTM D226/D4869 synthetic underlayment requirements
goldenItems.materialCanaryNote: Must be tagged ["asphalt_shingle"] — not ["all"]. This is the asphalt-specific underlayment provision; tagging it all conflates it with cedar/metal requirements.

goldenItems.description: Wood structural panels for roof sheathing — minimum thickness, span rating, and attachment requirements
Fire separation between attached garages and dwelling — 1/2-inch gypsum board on garage side; triggers roof scope when decking or sheathing is replaced in the soffit-adjacent area
goldenItems.canaryNote: The fire-separation canary. Must be a 'found' candidate item, never a gap. A run that misses this or parks it as a gap fails the eval.

goldenItems.description: Drip edge and eave flashing requirements for asphalt shingle roofs — minimum 2-inch horizontal leg, corrosion-resistant metal
goldenItems.materialCanaryNote: Must be tagged ["asphalt_shingle"] — this provision lives inside R905.2 (asphalt shingles) and does not apply to metal or wood roofing.

goldenItems.description: Reroofing — materials, load capacity, and permit trigger when existing roof is being replaced or recovered
Roof covering application must follow manufacturer installation instructions and code minimum requirements — manufacturer instructions govern when more restrictive
Flashing at wall-to-roof intersections — corrosion-resistant metal, minimum dimensions, counter-flashing requirements
Weather-resistant barrier (WRB) provisions — required behind exterior wall cladding; applies to wall sections disturbed by roofing work at rakes and eaves
Permit threshold for roof decking replacement — replacement of roof sheathing or structural decking requires a permit; repair of less than 25% in any 12-month period may qualify for exemption
Wood shingles — installation requirements for wood shingle roof coverings including underlayment, fastening, exposure, and deck requirements specific to wood shingles
goldenItems.materialCanaryNote: Must be tagged ["wood_shingle"] — this is the wood-shingle-specific installation section. A run that tags it ["all"] fails the material canary.

goldenItems.description: Wood shakes — installation requirements for wood shake roof coverings including interlayment felt, fastening, exposure, and specific moisture management requirements for shakes
goldenItems.materialCanaryNote: Must be tagged ["cedar_shake"] — this is the cedar/wood shake section. Together with R905.2 and R905.7, a run must produce separate items with distinct material tags across these three sections.

materialCanaryCheck.description: Items with isMaterialCanary=true must be tagged with a specific material code (not ["all"]). A run where every item tags ["all"] fails regardless of recall.
